name: Bretazenil
summary: Bretazenil (Ro16-6028) is an imidazopyrrolobenzodiazepine anxiolytic drug which is derived from the benzodiazepine family, and was invented in 1988. It is most closely related in structure to the GABA antagonist flumazenil, although its effects are somewhat different. It is classified as a high-potency benzodiazepine due to its high affinity binding to benzodiazepine binding sites where it acts as a partial agonist.

pharmacology.text: Bretazenil has a more broad spectrum of action than traditional benzodiazepines as it has been shown to have low affinity binding to α4 and α6 GABAA receptors in addition to acting on α1, α2, α3 and α5 subunits which traditional benzodiazepine drugs work on. The partial agonist imidazenil does not, however, act at these subunits.

zhOther: 查爾斯·埃蘭德, 查理·艾德勒
zhHansOther: 查尔斯·埃兰德, 查理·艾德勒

uses.en: It was studied as an anti-anxiety and anticonvulsant drug meant to cause less sedation and less dependence than ordinary benzodiazepines, but it was never marketed.
uses.zh: 它曾作為抗焦慮與抗癲癇藥物被研究，目的是比一般苯二氮平類造成較少鎮靜與依賴，但從未上市。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为抗焦虑与抗癫痫药物被研究，目的是比一般苯二氮平类造成较少镇静与依赖，但从未上市。

sideEffects.en: In trials the reported effects included drowsiness and poor coordination, though less than with full benzodiazepines. Because it only partly activates the receptor, it can bring on withdrawal in someone already dependent on benzodiazepines.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中回報的反應包括嗜睡與協調變差，但程度低於完全促效的苯二氮平類。由於它只部分活化受體，可能在已對苯二氮平類依賴者身上引發戒斷。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中回报的反应包括嗜睡与协调制差，但程度低于完全促效的苯二氮平类。由于它只部分活化受体，可能在已对苯二氮平类依赖者身上引发戒断。

fact.en: It was invented in 1988 as a partial agonist, meaning it turns the benzodiazepine site on only part way. Structurally it is closest to flumazenil, the drug used to reverse benzodiazepines.
fact.zh: 溴他西尼於 1988 年被合成，是部分促效劑，意思是它只部分開啟苯二氮平結合位。在結構上，它最接近用於逆轉苯二氮平作用的藥物 flumazenil。
fact.zhHans: 溴他西尼于 1988 年被合成，是部分促效剂，意思是它只部分打开苯二氮平结合位。在结构上，它最接近用于逆转苯二氮平作用的药物 flumazenil。
